The rollout left api-c on `SCHEMA_MODE=legacy` while the current configmap uses `SCHEMA_MODE=current`. Its logs showed a coupon checkout schema error, explaining the failures despite all pods being Ready on the same image.

I replaced only api-c from the current config generation and documented the cause and repair in `REPORT.txt`. Validation: `./ctl verify` returned `VERIFY PASS 300/300`.
